Ledgerly's AI bookkeeper can't replace your accountant

By Priya Nair · November 15, 2026

We ran Ledgerly's new AI reconciliation on three months of a bakery's books. It matched 412 of 418 transactions on the first pass and flagged the other six for review, faster and cleaner than any tool we have tested this year. The headline is only a reminder: you still need an accountant at tax time. For day-to-day books, Ledgerly is now our top pick for businesses under 20 staff.
